messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT alert 1 potential exfil via auth-service outbound webhooks. id=INC-2601234567 severity=high affected=auth-service-prod
raj: paging oncall @kim 1 noticed repetitive 200 responses to external host in last 4m
kim: oncall here, looking. which endpoint and sample payloads?
maria: observability flagged callbacks to /callbacks/verify with header X-Client-Cert and query client_id=zz-omega
javi: I traced one URL in logs: http://collector.bad-domain.example/cb?cid=zz-omega
kim: ack. recommend immediate egress block to that IP and rotate webhook secret. i'll avoid scaling pods down for now
raj: Agree. Block egress via netpol first. We should snapshot logs before rotating anything
tina-sec: Applying deny rule now for 203.0.113.45 and 203.0.113.46. Pushing NETPOL-2601
ops-bot: netpol-change submitted by tina-sec. ticket=NETPOL-2601
kim: searching pod logs:
```
kubectl logs -l app=auth-service -n prod --since=15m | grep -E "collector.bad-domain|X-Client-Cert|callbacks/verify"
```
maria: pulled 19 matching lines. redacted sample:
maria: "{\"callback_url\":\"http://collector.bad-domain.example/cb?cid=zz-omega\", \"user\":\"acct_9999\", \"headers\":{\"X-Client-Cert\":\"-----BEGIN CERT...\"}}"
raj: acct_9999 shows up 7x. Potential PII/key exposure. Escalating to privacy/legal
legal-ops: legal pinged. preserve chain of custody and flag if certs are in cleartext
javi: taking forensic snapshot of 3 auth-service pods and uploading to s3://forensics/INC-2601234567/ checksums recorded
tina-sec: rotating webhook signing secret in Vault: secret/redwood/webhooks/prod/auth-service
kim: rotation command executed. services reloaded. also recommend revoking any service tokens used by auth-service in last 24h
raj: adding gateway denylist for collector.bad-domain.example and its resolved IPs
maria: customer impact: inbound auth unaffected. only outbound callbacks blocked. ICM=low for availability, but potential confidentiality risk. filing CUST-2601
legal-ops: if cert material is confirmed exfiltrated, notify affected tenant (acct_9999). Otherwise monitor
ops-bot: containment applied. next steps: forensic analysis=javi, token rotations=tina-sec, customer comms=maria, postmortem=kim
maria: drafting customer message: "We detected unauthorized outbound webhook callbacks from auth-service to an external host. We contained the activity, rotated secrets, and are investigating whether customer certificate material was exposed. We will notify if affected." please review
legal-ops: review complete. wait on forensics before sending tenant notice
kim: creating postmortem ticket PM-2601234567 and scheduling 1hr blameless review tomorrow
raj: thanks team. keeping this thread for live updates :thumbsup:
ops-bot: timeline saved. first_message_ts=2601234567 last_message_ts=2601234730
